subject.title: Feature Request: User-Level Skill Preferences/Conventions Support

question: Should OpenClaw add a core per-skill user preference sidecar contract, and if so what filename, precedence, and refresh semantics should be canonical?
rationale: The request changes model-facing skill context and loader precedence, and current ClawHub/bundle-style skill packaging cannot by itself make OpenClaw auto-append user-specific sidecars to triggered skills.

options.title: Approve markdown sidecar
options.body: Standardize a low-precedence `preferences.md` or `conventions.md` contract and update loader, prompt versioning, watcher invalidation, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Use structured skill config
options.body: Keep prompt files `SKILL.md`-only and express user preferences through `skills.entries.<key>.config`, with docs and skill-runtime examples instead of sidecar loading.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Leave personal conventions as manually read skill-local files or ClawHub package guidance, accepting the current non-framework workaround.

recommendation.title: Approve markdown sidecar
recommendation.body: Standardize a low-precedence `preferences.md` or `conventions.md` contract and update loader, prompt versioning, watcher invalidation, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest routing candidate from recent skill loading, docs, ClawHub, and containment history for this product/API choice.
